Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.platform

Interface BucketOperations

public interface BucketOperations
Loader-specific primitives used by the shared FluidTransactions and HeldTransfers orchestration and by shared bucket items directly. This interface is the whole server-side loader surface: the dispenser's automation player, a sided block-storage probe and one-unit move, arbitrary-fluid world placement, per-fluid fill/empty sounds, native powder-snow placement finalization, fluid presentation, held-container fluid moves, item-inventory detection, the item pickup and toss events, the player block-break and block-place protection events, and the Forge FillBucketEvent carve-out.

World-operation methods are called on both logical sides. Unless stated otherwise, a true result means an accepted client prediction or a completed server operation; false means the operation was rejected without changing bucket or world state. The server is authoritative. Keep signatures in vanilla and StoredFluid terms; convert loader-native fluid values at the loader boundary.

    • beforeWorldBucketUse

      @Nullable net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult beforeWorldBucketUse(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, Supplier<net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult> hit)
      Forge-only lazy pre-dispatch hook firing FillBucketEvent. NeoForge and Fabric return null without resolving hit. Common code treats null as "continue normal bucket processing". Only cancellation is honored; a listener cannot substitute a filled bucket for a Some Buckets item. The supplier may return null when no block operation should be announced.
      Returns:
      InteractionResult.FAIL when a Forge listener cancelled the use, or null to continue

    • releasedFluidVariantIsRawTag

      boolean releasedFluidVariantIsRawTag()
      Whether this loader's 1.21.1 release saved a stored fluid's variant as the loader's native raw tag rather than an encoded component patch. Only Forge does, because its fluid stack carried a free-form tag; NeoForge and Fabric return false.

    • placeArbitraryFluid

      boolean placeArbitraryFluid(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, ProtectionContext context, StoredFluid stored, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Places one bucket-volume of stored into the world honoring the loader's vaporization, block-state, and empty-sound rules. Checks Protections.mayModify(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.core.Direction, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack), emits the fluid-place game event, and on server success debits a finite bucket while leaving a Source Bucket unchanged.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted client prediction or a completed server placement
